Author: Mayo Botic, Ultranova Violet
Name: PF Analysis
Description: Manage your Party Finder recruitment and see who you are playing with. Save duty, objective, role and condition setups as presets and apply any of them in one click; watch your listing and party as it fills; and look up party members' progression and community ratings.
Punchline: Run your Party Finder: presets, party progression, and player lookups.
Changelog: Everyone's vote on you now counts once. Rating the same person again used to stack another vote on top of the last one, so a group who play together every week piled up hundreds between them - a score of +300 could be eight people rather than three hundred. Your vote is a position now: upvote somebody and you have upvoted them, however many times you press it, and downvoting them later moves your one vote across instead of adding to it. You can change your mind whenever you like, with no day to wait out first - what counts is the last thing you said. Every vote is worth the same, from anybody. Existing scores were rebuilt to match, and almost nobody's percentage moved. Clears loads sixteen at a time as you scroll instead of numbered pages and remembers where you were, and a clear arriving while you read no longer shoves the list around - a button floats at the top of it instead. New My clears tab: every clear of your own that has gone up on the feed.

Author: Mayo Botic
Name: DutyDM
Description: Get a Discord DM the instant your duty pops. Join the DutyDM Discord server, enter your Discord username, and the bot will message you the moment your queue is ready - with an in-game popup confirming it sent.
Punchline: Duty-pop alerts straight to your Discord DMs.
Changelog: Party-full alerts now only fire when the last seat fills while you wait (7 -> 8), and are blocked for 30 seconds after leaving a duty. Joining an already-full PF or re-forming after an instance no longer sends a redundant notification.
